N_points.description: Number of points in frequency domain.

flavors.description: Contains the flavors. So far only implemented for 'up' and 'down'.

J.description: Hund's coupling in the Hubbard-Kanamori Hamiltonian (rotational-invariant systems).

Up.description: Inter-orbital interaction among opposite spins in the Hubbard-Kanamori Hamiltonian.

Upp.description: Inter-orbital interaction among same spins in the Hubbard-Kanamori Hamiltonian.

strict.description: Raises an error if a json validation fails. Default is 'False'.
